name: workflow-orchestrator
description: Generic, project-agnostic pipeline orchestrator. Drives a project's docs/WORKFLOW.md in defined order with binding gates and per-phase output checks via the /workflow-start command, and ships the fleet mechanics for running a workflow across named background agents: an Agents side pane (model, activity, tokens, context per agent; click a row to view it), a context gauge for the main session, and an opt-in context watch (/hr-watch, /hr-off; tools agents, hr_watch, hr_off) that asks for a handoff at a threshold and, in auto mode, clears and resumes the session.
